author: Inside Edition
description: Brooklyn's Bushwick neighborhood is an unlikely place to find a large population of rare geckos, spinks and other lizards. But thanks to the efforts of two conservation-minded animal lovers, several breeds of endangered reptiles call the borough home. The Gecko Gallery NYC's co-founder, Joseph Migirov, tells Inside Edition Digital that, "Unfortunately in many cases there's just no wild for these animals to go back to."
title: Visit The Unlikely Urban Home To Rare And Endangered Geckos
